text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Ben Ali chairs meeting of politburo of ruling party RCD. Elections for next party congress at grassroots level must be transparent. Party's student organisation to hold congress on August 4-5.
- Forum on export policy held to prepare for first meeting of High Exports Committee in June under President Ben Ali's chairmanship.
- Tunisia and Gambia to reinforce bilateral cooperation on environment.
- Trade Minister Zenaidi says aim is to boost export capacity.
- U.N. Secretary-General Kofi Annan says in interview that Tunisia has always supported United Nations; says peace cannot be imposed.
- Tunisia, in step aiming at integration with world financial markets, allows resident banks to have spot and forward forex transactions with foreign banks.
- Prime Minister Karoui says Tunisia successful in efforts to integrate with world economy.
